title: Career Roadmap — EV Service Advisor
summary: An EV Service Advisor acts as the link between electric-vehicle customers and the service workshop. The role involves understanding customer complaints, coordinating vehicle inspections and repairs, explaining service requirements, preparing estimates, tracking repair progress, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

blocks.text: An EV Service Advisor acts as the link between electric-vehicle customers and the service workshop. The role involves understanding customer complaints, coordinating vehicle inspections and repairs, explaining service requirements, preparing estimates, tracking repair progress, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

For a B.Voc graduate specializing in Electric Vehicle Technology, this is a practical career pathway combining technical EV knowledge, customer service, workshop operations, and service documentation.

blocks.label: Primary career skills
blocks.text: EV fundamentals, battery systems, diagnostic tools, service coordination, warranty handling, customer communication, and workshop management.

rows.text: Regional Service Manager, EV Service Operations Head

blocks.label: Safety is essential
blocks.text: high-voltage battery inspection and repair must be performed only by appropriately trained and authorized personnel using prescribed procedures and protective equipment.
Project 1 — EV Service Job Card System
Create sample job cards containing customer complaints, vehicle details, inspection notes, estimated costs, technician assignment, and delivery status.
Project 2 — EV Troubleshooting Guide
Document common charging, battery, warning-light, and low-voltage-system complaints, along with appropriate diagnostic escalation steps.
Project 3 — Service Cost Estimator
Build an Excel workbook to estimate labour, spare parts, consumables, applicable taxes, and total service cost.
Project 4 — Workshop Performance Dashboard
Use Excel or Power BI to track repair turnaround, repeat complaints, customer satisfaction, and service revenue.
Project 5 — Customer Service Simulation
Practice handling a customer complaint about reduced driving range, a charging failure, or a delayed repair. Prepare a professional response and escalation workflow.
Look for internships or trainee positions at:
Relevant titles include EV Service Intern, Service Advisor Trainee, Workshop Operations Intern, Automotive Service Intern, and EV Technical Support Trainee.
Prioritize placements that offer supervised exposure to vehicle intake, diagnostic workflows, repair estimates, warranty processes, and customer communication.

A future-ready Service Advisor should be able to interpret digital diagnostic information, explain findings accurately, and coordinate appropriate technical action.
By graduation, the student should be able to manage a simulated EV service case from initial complaint to delivery:

The student should ideally graduate with one EV service internship, familiarity with job cards and warranty processes, EV diagnostics fundamentals, customer-handling experience, Excel skills, and documented service-operation projects.
Best Overall Positioning
B.Voc – Electric Vehicle Technology → EV Service Advisor is a practical pathway for students who enjoy automotive technology, customer interaction, and service operations.
The most important employability combination is EV Fundamentals + Diagnostics Awareness + Service Documentation + Warranty Handling + Customer Communication + Workshop Coordination.

For long-term growth, the student should build deeper expertise in EV technical support, battery service, fleet maintenance, or aftersales management rather than remaining limited to routine appointment scheduling and service reception.
